faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Jalaun UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts is 30th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: A total of 110 vacancies are available for the posts of Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper in Jalaun UP Anganwadi for the year 2026 recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for both Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts is Intermediate or equivalent. Candidates can have qualifications up to Postgraduate level.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying for these posts is between 18 years and 35 years. Specific age relaxation details, if any, should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided information, there is no application fee for any category of candidates (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How will the selection process be conducted?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts will be based on a merit list. This merit list will be prepared considering the marks obtained by candidates from Intermediate up to Postgraduate levels.

faq.question: Q7. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: The recruitment for Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts by Jalaun UP Anganwadi is on a contractual basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the contract terms.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to download and read the PDF thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates must visit the official website or use the provided online application link to submit their forms.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for Jalaun UP Anganwadi recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for Jalaun UP Anganwadi recruitment is https://www.upanganwadibharti.in. All relevant information and application procedures will be available on this portal.
